notes: Short summary: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Primary pain: slow semantic search on large product docs, high cost from current embedding pipeline. They started with Hosted for fast POC, moving to Dedicated if throughput/price match. Key quotes: "We need sub-50ms tail for product-search queries at 200 qps"; "Batch ingest job is killing our budget". Requirements: nightly bulk embedding (50k-200k docs/day), real-time query throughput 150-250 qps, 95th percentile latency <50ms for cached queries, fallback model for capacity constraints. Tech notes: currently use a hybrid stack - embedding generation with OpenAI embeddings -> indexed into Pinecone; product search runs reranking on the app side. They want evaluation of running embeddings in Redwood (cost per 1k vectors), integration patterns with vector DBs (push vs host index), and recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce GPU footprint. Security: SSO via Okta, want KMS for key separation and audit logs retained 1 year. Compliance: likely SOC2 required. POC constraints: 30-day POC, Redwood to provide streaming test harness and bulk-ingest runbook. Upcoming asks: detailed Dedicated pricing for reserve 4-8 vGPUs, sample latency and cost estimates on 512-dim and 1536-dim embeddings, pattern for connecting Redwood -> Pinecone (or migrating to Redwood-hosted index). Next actions: Jordan to send SOW draft and pricing spreadsheet; Riley to share POC telemetry template; Samira to join contract talks once pricing aligned. Sticking points: need clearer SLA on Dedicated pools and fallback behavior; legal wants data residency guarantee for EU customers (some customers on EU-only data). Quick notes from last call: "If we can get predictable cost for nightly embed runs and reliable 200 qps for search, we'll be greenlit".
